newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks little changed in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks little changed in London.

text.p: Most Hong Kong shares were unchanged in late trading in London on Wednesday.
In otherwise featureless dealings, shares in HSBC Holdings added about HK$1.75 from their closing levels in New York, buoyed by gains in the London share market, dealers said.
"Nothing else has moved. The rest of the market has been terribly dull," said one London dealer.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 8.83 points to 12,435.51 at 1530 GMT.
In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng index finished 28.11 points higher at 12,426.68.
